description: Source code for a tool that reads and interprets TFFS partitions in AVM Fritz!Box devices, including functions for parsing entries, key-value pairs, and command-line options.

methods.name: get_header_len
methods.description: Returns the length of a TFFS entry header, considering byte swapping.

methods.name: get_header_id
methods.description: Returns the ID of a TFFS entry header, considering byte swapping.

methods.name: to_entry_header_id
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit name ID to a 16-bit entry header ID, considering byte swapping.

methods.name: get_walk_size
methods.description: Calculates the size to walk for an entry, aligned to 4 bytes.

methods.name: print_entry_value
methods.description: Prints the value of a TFFS entry to stdout.

methods.name: parse_entry
methods.description: Parses a buffer segment into a TFFS entry structure.

methods.name: find_entry
methods.description: Finds a specific entry in the buffer by ID.

methods.name: parse_key_names
methods.description: Parses key names from a name table entry.

methods.name: show_all_key_value_pairs
methods.description: Displays all key-value pairs found in the buffer.

methods.name: show_matching_key_value
methods.description: Displays the value for a specific key name.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options and sets global flags.
